NEW_COUNTERPARTIES.label: first payment between the two accounts

ESTABLISHED_COUNTERPARTIES.label: 3+ earlier payments between the two accounts, the first 3+ days before

PASS_THROUGH.label: paid out within 24 h of receiving a similar amount ($1,000+) from someone else

FAST_ONWARD_TRANSFER.label: the receiver sent 50%+ of the payment on within 24 h

DORMANT_THEN_ACTIVE.label: no earlier outgoing payment, then 3+ payments in a day

EQUAL_SPLITS.label: 3+ receivers that day with near-identical totals

CONVERGENCE.label: one beneficiary reached through 2+ middle accounts of one sender, the same day

ROUND_TRIP.label: money back to the sender within 4 hops, each within 72 h

CYCLE.label: a time-ordered loop back to the sender within 4 days

CASH_OR_CRYPTO_EXIT.label: the receiver paid out in cash or Bitcoin within 72 h
